name: Adhesive plaster
summary: Sticking plaster strip with a padded centre and tiny holes, at a slight angle. Use for small cuts and first-aid moments.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the lowest corner rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 about 450 px long; use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: color
params.note: strip colour: a skin tone, or a fun colour

params.name: anim
params.note: pop = scales in with a small overshoot
